program_identity.name: Clstr Campus Ambassador Program
program_identity.tagline: Build your network, earn rewards, and unlock real opportunities, not just a title.
program_identity.positioning: Most ambassador programs give you tasks. Clstr gives you ownership.
program_identity.social_proof: Already active across 47 colleges (45 verified nodes, 575 registered students)
program_identity.scope: Weekly community activation, event participation, and peer-to-peer onboarding for your campus network.

differentiators: Real leadership ownership in your college ecosystem
Real impact through campaigns, communities, and events
Direct access to alumni, founders, and growth mentors

core_activities: Organize campaigns, activations, and campus events
Represent Clstr as an official campus leader
Peer-to-peer onboarding of students to the campus network

benefits_and_perks.resume: Official selection letter and a leadership role that stands out
benefits_and_perks.internship_access: Top performers receive internship opportunities and letter of recommendation support
benefits_and_perks.rewards: Amazon vouchers, cash incentives, and performance-based perks
benefits_and_perks.recognition_goodies: Hoodies, caps, exclusive merch, and featured recognition
benefits_and_perks.network: Direct access to alumni, founders, and high-agency student peers

outcomes: Official ambassador title with selection letter
Internship + LOR opportunity for top performers
Real campus impact — events, campaigns, community building

apply_if: You enjoy networking, organizing, and bringing people together
You want impact and opportunities, not just certificates
do_not_apply_if: You are only looking for certificates
eligibility.requirement: Any currently enrolled student can apply. No prior ambassador experience required.

steps: Apply — Fill the form in a few minutes
Review — Team reviews fit and intent
Onboarding Call — Meet the team and align on campus plan
Activation — Start building your campus community

faqs.a: Any enrolled student wanting leadership experience.
Top performers are eligible for vouchers, performance perks, and growth opportunities.

faqs.q: How many ambassadors are selected per college?

outreach_intelligence.key_hook_for_dms: Ownership, not just tasks — real impact at your campus
outreach_intelligence.prospect_pain_addressed: Tired of ambassador programs that only give certificates

role_fit_mapping.first_message_angle: Ask about their campus experience, NOT pitch clstr immediately
role_fit_mapping.conversion_trigger: When they show interest — share form: https://forms.gle/2NYjiunqeUk3WUDh9 + WhatsApp: 9441467303

guidebook_metadata.ownership_level: You are the Clstr founder on campus (Campus Captain)
guidebook_metadata.compensation_policy: No external funding. Recognition, merchandise, VIP passes, and equity/surplus sharing once events generate surplus.

domain_leads.mission: Get every club on Clstr and every event posted here first
Connect students with opportunities and alumni mentors via TPO
Keep the campus feed active, quality, and campus-native
Drive new student registrations and campus visibility
Get students building together via CollabHub and EcoCampus

campus_captain_team_structure.foot_soldiers: Up to 5 student volunteers per campus supporting weekly sprints

M02.reward: Clstr tee + free VIP passes to every Vizag Community event + LinkedIn/IG shoutout

M03.target: 1,500 verified users + all domain clubs active
M03.reward: Official Clstr Campus Leader Certificate signed by Founder

M04.reward: Promotion to Campus Node Coordinator (L2 Leader) + official recommendation letter

M05.reward: Core team fast-track interview / paid internship + Founder LinkedIn recommendation

field_issue_playbook.fix: Get TPO/faculty to post placement shortlists or deadlines exclusively on Clstr.
Use WhatsApp as distribution link ('Full update + RSVP on Clstr').
Give ONE clear visible weekly task per lead; praise small wins publicly; replace non-responsive leads.
Have students open inbox before initiating signup; walk first 10 students through signup in person.

field_issue_playbook.issue: Clubs say yes but don't post
field_issue_playbook.fix: Sit with club president and post the first event for them on phone.
